topics.name: Reference Implementation Profile
topics.purpose: Define a non-authoritative reference implementation profile for Contract Format 1.4, separating normative format semantics from language-specific implementation guidance.

semantics.normative_rule: Canonical contracts define normative semantics; reference code does not.
semantics.profile_rule: Reference implementation declares language/runtime/version and supported conformance profile.
semantics.python_rule: Python-specific guidance may be provided as one implementation reference, never as universal format truth.
semantics.behavior_rule: Reference implementation must pass the same public fixture suite as any independent implementation.
semantics.replacement_rule: An independent implementation is conformant if it satisfies the normative contracts/tests even when architecture/code differs.
semantics.bug_rule: If reference code conflicts with normative contract, contract wins and reference code is defective.

invariants.rule: A Contract Format 1.4 conformance claim is backed by reproducible machine-readable fixtures, validation results and exact profile/version identity.

hard_gates.condition: reference code treated as higher authority than contract
Python behavior declared universal without contract basis
independent conformant implementation rejected for different internal architecture
reference implementation exempted from fixture suite
code bug silently changes normative semantics
